query: INSERT INTO refund (id, org_id, provider_refund_id, charge_id, amount_cents, currency, status, reason, mail_requested_at, mail_due_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $9, $10, $10) ON CONFLICT (provider_refund_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, amount_cents = EXCLUDED.amount_cents, org_id = coalesce(refund.org_id, EXCLUDED.org_id), reason = coalesce(refund.reason, EXCLUDED.reason), updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS "inserted!"
